// Generated by fizzyx. Do not edit.

import type { ReactNode } from "react"

export type AdminSurface = "page" | "dialog" | "sheet"

export type AdminCellRenderer = (value: unknown, row: Record<string, unknown>) => ReactNode

export interface AdminColumnConfig {
  cell?: string
  hidden?: boolean
}

/**
 * Applies user-owned adminConfig column overrides to the generated columns:
 * drops columns marked hidden and resolves each `cell` key through the cell registry.
 * With the default empty config and registry this returns the columns unchanged.
 */
export function applyAdminColumns<Column extends { key: string }>(
  columns: readonly Column[],
  config: Record<string, AdminColumnConfig> | undefined,
  cells: Record<string, AdminCellRenderer>,
): Array<Column & { render?: AdminCellRenderer }> {
  return columns
    .filter((column) => !config?.[column.key]?.hidden)
    .map((column) => {
      const cellKey = config?.[column.key]?.cell
      if (!cellKey) return column
      const render = cells[cellKey]
      if (!render) throw new Error(`Unknown admin cell registry key: ${cellKey}`)
      return { ...column, render }
    })
}

export interface AdminApiError {
  message: string
  status?: number
  code?: string
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, readonly string[]>
  cause?: unknown
}

export type AdminNotification = {
  type: "success" | "error" | "info"
  title: string
  description?: string
}

export type AdminNotifier = (notification: AdminNotification) => void

function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
  return value !== null && typeof value === "object" ? value as Record<string, unknown> : undefined
}

export function readAdminPath(value: unknown, path?: string): unknown {
  if (!path) return value
  return path.split(".").reduce<unknown>((current, segment) => asRecord(current)?.[segment], value)
}

export function readAdminNumberPath(value: unknown, path?: string): number | undefined {
  const candidate = readAdminPath(value, path)
  return typeof candidate === "number" && Number.isFinite(candidate) ? candidate : undefined
}

export function normalizeAdminApiError(error: unknown, fallback = "Something went wrong."): AdminApiError {
  if (typeof error === "string") return { message: error }
  const source = asRecord(error)
  const response = asRecord(source?.response)
  const data = asRecord(response?.data) ?? asRecord(source?.data)
  const message = data?.message ?? source?.message
  const status = response?.status ?? source?.status
  const code = data?.code ?? source?.code
  const fieldErrors = asRecord(data?.fieldErrors ?? source?.fieldErrors)
  return {
    message: typeof message === "string" && message ? message : fallback,
    status: typeof status === "number" ? status : undefined,
    code: typeof code === "string" ? code : undefined,
    fieldErrors: fieldErrors ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(fieldErrors).map(([key, value]) => [key, Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(String) : [String(value)]])) : undefined,
    cause: error,
  }
}
